verdict.rationale: CSC's own docs promise same-day, secure scanning and delivery of SOP documents, with OCR, time stamps, searchable PDFs and electronic delivery per routing preferences. Its registered-agent and SOP representation covers all 50 states, DC and international jurisdictions, and SOP delivery is tied to the CSCNavigator dashboard. missing for 10: explicit statement that SOP is accepted at a physical street-address office, explicit confirmation that scans land in the customer's online account rather than just being delivered electronically, independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day turnaround.
